method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: US Stocks Fall as Rising Oil Prices, Yields Offset Chip Gains
Equities.reason: Broad-market risk-off: rising oil and higher yields are driving a selloff that offsets tech/chip strength. High relevance because it captures the cross-market drivers (oil, rates) that are moving major indices.

Equities.title: Rising Yields Threaten to Puncture Asia’s AI-Driven Stock Rally
Equities.reason: Narrative: higher global yields are a direct headwind to the AI-led rally in Asian equities. Relevant to equity regime because it pits the AI leadership theme against macro liquidity/rate pressures.

Equities.title: Equities: Stagflation fears weigh on US stocks – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists note that rising oil prices are reinforcing stagflation concerns and weighing on equities globally.
Equities.reason: Macro interpretation: oil-driven stagflation fears dampen equity risk appetite and argue for more cautious positioning; useful signal for broad market regime and sector sensitivity to commodity-driven inflation.

Equities.title: Indian shares set for muted open as oil tops $91, US-Iran ceasefire expires
Equities.reason: EM/regional risk signal: rising oil and renewed US-Iran tensions are weighing on Indian equity openings — reflects wider risk-off flows into EM equities and regional sensitivity to geopolitics.

Equities.title: Stock Market Today: Global Bond Rout Deepens
Equities.reason: Rates-driven equity pressure: a deepening global bond selloff (higher yields) is a primary driver of falling equities and erodes multiple/valuation upside. High relevance as it reflects a market-wide regime shift (bond-equity linkage).

Equities.title: Santoli: Earnings bonanza that lifted market to record may not be all that it appears to be
Equities.summary: The S&P 500 is up more than 6% in 12 trading days to record levels.
Equities.reason: Cautionary earnings narrative: questions about quality/durability of the earnings-driven rally increase vulnerability to macro shocks (rates/oil). Lower relevance than macro rates/oil items but important for positioning and sentiment.

Equities.title: Nvidia backing $105 billion in financing for OpenAI data center in Ohio
Equities.summary: Technology giants are shelling out billions to scale capacity to meet massive data center demand.
Equities.reason: Pro-risk / AI leadership signal: large-scale financing for AI data center capacity supports continued structural demand for AI hardware/software, bolstering mega-cap tech leadership even amid broader market risk-off.

Rates.title: US 30-year yields hit highest level since 2007 as war, oil worries fester
Rates.reason: 30-year Treasury yield at multi-decade highs driven by geopolitical (Iran/war) and oil risk; clear bond selloff -> negative for bond prices / positive for yields, high market-moving relevance for Rates.

Rates.title: US Bond Selloff Drives 30-Year Yields to Highest Since 2007
Rates.reason: Reinforces US-focused bond selloff narrative; confirms sustained upward pressure on long-term yields — negative for rates but somewhat redundant with other major headlines.

Rates.title: Fiscal concerns and doubts on Fed independence send US yields to long-term highs
Rates.summary: US Treasury yields keep rising across the curve this week, with the yield for the 30-year Treasury bond reaching its highest level since 2007, during the global financial crisis, at 5.33% so far on Monday.
Rates.reason: Adds structural driver (US fiscal worries and perceived pressure on Fed independence) to rising yields story — negative for bond prices and important for medium-term Rates outlook.

Rates.title: Selling grips bond markets from US to Japan as inflation, fiscal worries take hold
Rates.reason: Describes a broad, cross-market bond selloff (US to Japan) driven by inflation and fiscal concerns — high relevance as it signals a global rates regime shift (higher-for-longer yields).

Rates.title: Global Bond Slump Sends Long-Term Borrowing Costs to Highest in Decades
Rates.reason: Broad narrative of long-term borrowing costs rising worldwide; reinforces negative rates impulse and the risk of entrenched higher yields.

Rates.title: Global Bond Rout Deepens as Oil Holds Above $90
Rates.reason: Links higher oil and geopolitical risk to worsening bond rout — supports the dominant negative rates narrative driven by energy/inflation and risk premia.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: Bond investors in revolt as Iran threatens to go 'fully offensive'
Rates.reason: Market commentary highlighting geopolitical escalation as a near-term driver of bond selling — negative for yields and trader positioning, moderate relevance for intraday/near-term Rates moves.

Rates.title: The 30-year Treasury yield just hit a 19-year high. Three things could drive it even higher
Rates.summary: The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury has surged to its highest level in 19 years, and some strategists see scope for the move to go further.
Rates.reason: Analytical piece identifying upside drivers for long-end yields — negative for bond prices but more situational/strategic than immediate market news.

Rates.title: Traders Short French Bonds as Fight Over Budget Set to Escalate
Rates.reason: Shows targeted sovereign stress in Europe with traders positioning for higher yields — negative for European govies and supportive of broader risk-off in fixed income.

Rates.title: Japan Five-Year Bond Sale Draws Strongest Demand Since June 2025
Rates.reason: Localized supportive note: strong demand at a JGB sale suggests pockets of safe-haven buying and technical support for Japanese rates — small positive counter-signal to the global selloff.

Rates.title: Traders Alert for Deeper Bond Rout Fueling Niche Arbitrage Trade
Rates.reason: Highlights market mechanics and the potential for further downside in bonds via arbitrage and positioning — negative for rates with modest relevance (trading/flow focus).

FX.title: United States Dollar Index extends recovery from two-month low; trades above 99.50
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, builds on the overnight goodish rebound from the 99.30 area, or the lowest level since June 5, and gains some follow-through traction on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY move: a renewed USD rebound is a broad FX driver (pressure on EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD/JPY). High relevance as it signals a market-wide USD bid that dominates other FX headlines.

FX.title: Japanese Yen hits drift closer to the key 160.00 level as risk appetite fades
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) accelerates its decline as the US Dollar (USD) draws support from a sourer market mood, with investors wary of a re-escalation of tensions in the Middle East.
FX.reason: JPY moving toward the 160 level is a material FX regime signal tied to risk-off and USD strength; elevated relevance given potential market and BoJ/FX reaction sensitivity.

FX.title: Euro: Overvaluation and energy risks weigh against US Dollar – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Halpenny notes that EUR/USD remains capped near its 200-day moving average at 1.1630 and is 2.5%-3.0% overvalued in the bank’s short-term model.
FX.reason: Bank FX view highlighting EUR/USD capped and overvalued — a euro-negative datapoint that reinforces the broader USD-support narrative; medium relevance (regional FX view, not market-moving on its own).

FX.title: Canadian Dollar receives support from firm oil prices
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its losses for the fourth successive day, trading around 1.3870 during the European hours on Tuesday. The currency pair depreciates as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) gains support from firming crude oil prices.
FX.reason: Commodity-led CAD strength (USD/CAD down) is a clear FX-native transmission from oil moves; relevance above average since CAD is oil-sensitive and this is a multi-day move.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Upside risk targets 0.7150 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that AUD/USD strength remains intact after a jump to 0.7129, though overbought conditions should confine intraday moves to a 0.7090–0.7130 band.
FX.reason: Bank technical/flow note that AUD retains upside vs USD; positive for AUD but limited scope — relevant to AUD flows and risk sentiment, not a market shock.

FX.title: Indian Rupee remains weak due to higher oil prices, RBI closes FCNR (B) window
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades with caution against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/INR is close to its fresh three-week high of 95.85 despite potential Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervention.
FX.reason: INR pressure tied to oil + potential RBI intervention is an FX-native story with clear local policy/flow implications — USD/INR strength is relevant for EM FX and local market risk.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar declines due to increased risk aversion
FX.summary: NZD/USD depreciates after two days of losses, trading around 0.5880 during the European hours on Tuesday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) holds ground on safe-haven flows amid escalating geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran.
FX.reason: NZD weakness via USD safe-haven flows is a typical risk-off FX transmission; relevant for commodity/Asia FX but not a standalone market shock.

FX.title: British Pound trades lower against US Dollar after soft UK employment data
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) is down 0.1% to near 1.3530 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday. The British currency comes under pressure after the release of the United Kingdom (UK) employment data for three months ending June.
FX.reason: Domestic UK payroll/employment softness reduces GBP rate-hike expectations vs USD — direct GBP-USD transmission and medium relevance for G10 FX.

FX.title: Chinese Companies Slow FX Sales in July as Yuan Support Fades
FX.reason: Headline implies fading yuan support and reduced RMB-supply into FX markets — important for EMFX and global USD flows; summary preserved as provided.

Commodities.title: Gold extends gains on easing rate-hike fears, markets await Fed minutes
Commodities.reason: Market narrative: gold benefiting from reduced rate-hike expectations / easing Fed fears (bullish for precious metals). This is a broad macro driver (rates -> gold) and is market-relevant, so assign high relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold sticks to losses below $4,400 as USD recovers further from two-month low
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) remains depressed below the $4,400 mark through the first half of the European session on Tuesday, snapping a two-day winning streak amid a broadly firmer US Dollar (USD).
Commodities.reason: Counter-signal: USD recovery weighing on gold intraday. Technical/FX-driven piece — relevant as a short-term drag but lower relevance vs. macro rate narrative.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.97 per troy ounce, down 1.25% from the $65.79 it cost on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Price-action/short-term: silver down modestly. Technical/price update with limited fundamental detail — low-to-moderate relevance for the commodity narrative.

Commodities.title: Brent: Rally extends above $91/bbl – ING
Commodities.summary: ING strategists Ewa Manthey and Warren Patterson note that Brent Oil has extended its rally, trading above $91/bbl as geopolitical risks and supply concerns support prices.
Commodities.reason: Strong bullish oil narrative: Brent rally driven by geopolitics and supply concerns. This is a market-moving commodity theme (higher oil risk premium) and merits high relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil Advances as the US Signals No Rush to End Conflict With Iran
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical driver: US signalling no rush to end conflict with Iran raises oil risk premium and supports prices. Important for crude market direction and risk sentiment.

Commodities.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
Commodities.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Sh
Commodities.reason: Flow/supply update: sharply higher U.S. Gulf-to-West shipments increase regional supply availability (bearish for West Coast refined/crude tightness). Regional but relevant to oil product balances.

Commodities.title: Have Middle East Oil Flows Rebounded to 15 Million Bpd as U.S. Claims?
Commodities.reason: Supply-side check: headline questions whether Middle East flows have rebounded — if true, this would add supply and cap prices. Article is relevant but uncertain/verification-focused, so given moderate-low relevance.

Commodities.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
Commodities.reason: Fundamental supply increase: record U.S. gas production is a significant bearish fundamental for natural gas prices (higher output -> downside pressure). High relevance for gas market.

Commodities.title: Supply Crunch Grips Copper Market as Key Spread Flares Out
Commodities.reason: Material supply-driven bullish copper narrative: reported supply crunch and spread dynamics point to tighter copper fundamentals — strong positive for copper prices and high relevance.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds $64,000 as surging yields and oil drain risk appetite
Crypto.reason: Macro shock: rising yields and weaker risk appetite are broad negative drivers for crypto as a risk asset—large-market macro narrative and liquidity squeeze.

Crypto.title: Coinbase-Circle USDC collaboration, FOMC minutes, oil price: Crypto Week Ahead
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin / payments rails collaboration between major players supports on‑ramps and utility for USDC—positive adoption / infrastructure signal for crypto.

Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity for stablecoins from Treasury is a major structural development—generally positive for institutional adoption and market confidence in stablecoin plumbing.

Crypto.reason: Exchange compliance / privacy breach undermines trust in a systemically important venue—negative for market confidence and regulatory scrutiny risk.

Crypto.title: How a bug in Coldcard’s code went unnoticed for years, leading to $100 million in hacked funds
Crypto.reason: Major hardware-wallet security failure increases custody risk premiums and could dent retail/institutional trust—negative for crypto demand.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin tracks equity bounce, but $390 million ETF outflow week keeps bulls on back foot
Crypto.reason: Net outflows from spot ETFs are a direct negative flow into BTC liquidity—material for near-term price dynamics.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin options remain expensive despite summer calm. Here's why it matters
Crypto.reason: Elevated options premia indicate persistent downside protection demand and higher implied volatility, a mild negative signal for risk-on positioning.

Crypto.title: The bitcoin futures market looks like a crowded club with a tiny exit – and it could cause pain
Crypto.reason: Concentration and leverage in futures raises liquidation tail‑risk for BTC—systemic negative for volatility and downside scenarios.

Crypto.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine now owns 4.8% of Ethereum supply after latest ETH purchase
Crypto.reason: Large accumulation by a named buyer reduces float and is supportive for ETH price dynamics—positive supply-side signal.

Crypto.title: No change in bitcoin holdings as Strategy boosted dollar reserve, bought back more STRC last week
Crypto.reason: Large institutional holders maintaining or not reducing BTC reserves is supportive for structural demand—mild positive.

Crypto.title: Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs: The difference between owning the coin and the fund
Crypto.reason: Educational piece on ETF vs direct ownership—low relevance but supportive of broader adoption narrative (limited market-moving value).

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rises above $64,000 as big AI compute deals continue to roll in
Crypto.reason: Flow-driven buying tied to AI/tech demand is a near-term positive catalyst for crypto risk appetite—counterbalances macro headwinds but lower relevance than macro/regulatory items.

Crypto.title: BitMart founder dismisses calls for audit as users report blocked funds, unpaid employees
Crypto.reason: Exchange operational failure and governance concerns at BitMart are negative for user trust and highlight contagion risk in smaller venues.
